purpose: Develop an online object-local confidence estimator on genuinely new HomebrewedDB Primesense sequences, then permit one sensor-and-scene-disjoint Kinect 2 sealed validation only if every development gate passes.

predecessor.reason: The static all-history quotient medoid reached +4.50% on all frames, -1.57% on natural missing frames, and a -7.10% hierarchical-bootstrap lower bound.

source.clock: Order frames by BOP image ID and use a nominal 30 Hz clock; hardware timestamps are unavailable.
source.coordinate_frame: Model-to-camera. HB scene_camera records intrinsics and depth scale but no world-to-camera trajectory.
source.association: Oracle scene_id plus object_id association. HB is a single-instance, multiple-object dataset; the builder must reject any frame containing duplicate instances of an object ID.
limitations: ground-truth visible masks as isolated pose-estimator inputs

development.labels: May be opened only after protocol, builder, inference runner, estimator, evaluator, and tests are committed together.

sealed.labels: Must remain unavailable until the frozen development gate passes. A failed development gate forbids download, bundle construction, or label access.

selection.observation_available: Visible mask area is at least 0.001 of the image, valid-depth ratio inside the visible mask is at least 0.5, and at least four visible masked depth pixels are valid.
selection.window_rule: For each scene/object track, among windows starting at an available frame choose the 128-source-frame window containing the most naturally unavailable frames; break ties by earliest start. Short final windows are ineligible.
selection.track_selection: Sort eligible tracks by SHA-256 of 'poseloop-m5-r4-development:' plus track_id and greedily retain tracks while enforcing the per-object cap.
selection.preinitialization: A selected window always starts at an available frame.

proposed_family.description: A causal quotient constant-twist estimator whose mask support, depth support, innovation scale, measurement gain, velocity gain, missing-frame motion permission, and reported uncertainty adapt only from the current track's past input and accepted measurements.
proposed_family.raw_foundationpose_score_policy: Record top score and margin for audit, but exclude both from filtering and confidence because consumed R3 diagnostics show they are not calibrated reliability probabilities.
proposed_family.candidate_selection: Leave one object ID out. In each fold choose the candidate with the greatest training macro-object relative improvement, breaking exact ties by candidate_order. Development evidence is the cross-fitted concatenation of held-out objects. The candidate frozen for sealed use is the modal fold winner, breaking ties by candidate_order.

evaluation.primary_aggregation: Equal-weight track mean within object, then equal-weight macro mean across represented objects.
evaluation.missing_frame_loss: The same track-then-object macro aggregation restricted to naturally unavailable frames.
evaluation.confidence_metric: Spearman correlation between proposed scalar uncertainty and proposed normalized pose error on naturally unavailable frames, computed over the cross-fitted held-out frames.

bootstrap.unit: Paired hierarchical resampling of represented objects, then complete tracks within sampled objects.
bootstrap.reported_bound: 10th percentile of cross-fitted paired relative macro-object improvement.

evaluation.stop_rule: Any failed development condition stops M5-R4. Do not download or inspect the Kinect 2 sealed archive.

sealed_policy.method: Freeze the modal development fold winner and every parameter before downloading sealed data.
sealed_policy.gate: Reuse every numerical development gate without relaxation.
sealed_policy.reopen_policy: The first evaluator-label open is final. Any method, configuration, selection, metric, or gate change requires a new protocol ID and genuinely new sensor/data split.

claim_boundary.development_allowed: Recorded HB Primesense development replay with nominal timing, oracle association, ground-truth visible masks, object-grouped cross-fitting, and natural input unavailability.
claim_boundary.sealed_allowed_if_passed: One Kinect 2, scene-disjoint HB validation of a Primesense-developed object-local adaptive confidence estimator.
forbidden: independent physical-instance count equal to frame or track count
retuning on consumed XYZ-IBD R2/R3 outcomes
accessing Kinect 2 sealed data after a failed development gate

execution_order: commit protocol, method, development builder, inference runner, evaluator, and tests before reading HB development pose labels
build the Primesense development bundle and record exact source/code/data hashes
run label-blind FoundationPose inference on every available selected development frame
evaluate all frozen candidates with leave-one-object-out cross-fitting
only after a full pass, freeze the modal candidate and create a separate sealed implementation commit
only then download Kinect 2 scenes 9-13 and perform one sealed-label open
